sources.confirms: exterior and interior assemblies mount on opposite faces, cables pass through the door bore

purpose.job: Lets the household see who is at the door and unlock without a key.

units.label: exterior unit
units.orientation: vertical, camera at the top facing outward

units.label: interior unit
units.orientation: vertical, screen at the top facing into the home

constraints.rule: A closed door shows at most one unit in one view.
constraints.prompt: only one side of the closed door is visible
constraints.check: No two units of the lock appear on the same face of a door.

constraints.rule: Exterior unit camera faces the visitor.
constraints.prompt: the camera module at the top faces outward toward the corridor
constraints.check: Camera faces outward, not into the home.

constraints.rule: Interior unit belongs to the home side.
constraints.prompt: mounted on the inside face of the door, home interior around it
constraints.check: Background is the home interior, not a corridor or garden.

forbidden.text: exterior and interior units side by side on the same face of a door
forbidden.negative: two lock panels on the same side of the door

forbidden.text: parts borrowed from other models (round screens, mascots)

liberties.text: Both units side by side on a neutral background, clearly not installed.
liberties.prompt: studio product layout on a seamless neutral background, not installed on a door

liberties.text: Divided split frame: outside on one half, inside on the other, with a visible divider.
liberties.prompt: split-screen composition with a clear divider, outside view on the left, inside view on the right

unknowns.question: Handle side vs door handing options
unknowns.blocks: close-ups of the handle on a specific door
